title: Change log line, v 1
description: One line of .opencode/workplan/<id>.history.jsonl (spec 06 X4, contracts §24): a committed write, appended under the commit's locks after the transaction completes. Parent-owned, outside the plan and state hashes, advisory: a lost append or an out-of-band edit is a gap, detected through the hashes. prev is the sha256 of the previous line's bytes (without its newline); a rotated log continues the chain in its next segment.

op.description: The journal operation label: create, create:overwrite, update, patch, checkpoint, compact:apply, reset:<mode>, recovery:<mode>.

source.description: Set by the trusted caller, never by model input.

path.description: goal, status, notes, findings/<index>, phases, phases/<phaseId>, phases/<phaseId>/steps, phases/<phaseId>/steps/<stepId>, plan, markdown, dependencies, checkpoint, evidence, lanes, ...

hashes.description: null: the plan did not exist (before) or no longer exists (after).
